instrument: Track B divinity-concept frame, v3 (twelve dimensions, proposition-level)
status: methodology proposal; not yet used to draw any historical conclusion
design_motivation: v2 claimed seven orthogonal dimensions but delivered two composite ones. D2 answered three questions at once — how many beings, whether the others are real, whether they may be worshipped — and D7 answered four — who speaks, what act, what genre, what commitment. Five further dimensions forced a single value where the texts plainly hold several at once. v3 splits D2 into D2a/D2b/D2c and D7 into D7a/D7b/D7c/D7d, makes D1, D3, D4, D5 and D6 set-valued, and moves the unit of analysis from the utterance window to the proposition, with the window retained as context. It also replaces the single refusal state with three separate fields, so that a record the frame will not count as affirmed doctrine is still available as evidence that a concept is represented in the text.

three_questions_kept_separate.conceptual_presence: Is this concept represented in the passage at all? Values: represented, not_represented_in_available_sources, undecidable_from_available_sources.
three_questions_kept_separate.doctrinal_endorsement: Does the framing voice affirm the proposition? This is not a thirteenth question: tools/divinity_ontology.py writes the field as D7d_epistemic_commitment's own value, so it carries that dimension's six values (endorsed_by_text, attributed_not_endorsed, rejected_in_text, suspended_or_held_open, not_applicable_non_assertive, undecidable) and cannot disagree with it except on a `not_yet_instrumented` row, where the record forces this field to `undecidable`. See distinctness_status.d7d_epistemic_commitment_and_doctrinal_endorsement.
three_questions_kept_separate.historical_transmission: Is there evidence that this concept travelled from an earlier source? Values: not_yet_assessable until dated original-language attestations and documented contact routes exist.

assertion_logic.rule: These three are never collapsed into one another and never merged into one field. A withheld endorsement is not an absence of the concept: the records the previous release refused are retained and are available for conceptual analysis, and are excluded only from the count of affirmative doctrinal claims.

removed_state.blocked_by_speech_act: dropped in v3. It answered two questions with one label and caused 54 records representing a concept to be treated as though they represented nothing.

D1_ontological_category.question: What kind of thing is divinity taken to be, in this proposition?
D1_ontological_category.note: Set-valued. A text can hold that the ultimate is a personal being AND the ground in which other beings subsist; forcing one label invented a contradiction the tradition did not assert.

values.personal_being: a being with mind, will and address, capable of being spoken to
values.impersonal_order_or_law: an order, law, ground or absolute that is not a being and has no mental states
values.animating_substance_or_power: sacred power as a quantifiable stuff or property that things may contain
values.collective_or_class: 'the divine' names a class of beings; no single member is the referent
values.manifestation_or_hypostasis: a visible face of a hidden depth; the addressed figure is not the whole
values.deified_mortal: divinity as an honour a formerly human person received
values.unknowable_or_conceptless: the ultimate is declared beyond the reach of these predicates
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D2a_acknowledged_population.question: How many divine beings does this proposition acknowledge?
D2a_acknowledged_population.note: A counting question only. It carries no claim about worship and none about the reality of the beings counted; both were split out of the old D2.

values.one_only: exactly one divine being is acknowledged in the proposition
values.two_polar: two complementary terms, neither reducible to the other
values.few_or_several: a small definite number, without ranking
values.many_graded: a plurality with ranks, offices, genealogy or a head
values.uncountable_or_numeric_scheme: plurality expressed as a doctrinal number or as myriads
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D2b_reality_of_others.question: What status do other divine beings have, relative to the one in question?
D2b_reality_of_others.note: The truth-claim about rivals, separated from the counting question and from the worship question. A proposition can acknowledge many beings (D2a) while denying they are real, or acknowledge one while treating the others as real and subordinate.

values.others_denied_unreal: other claimed divinities are explicitly not beings: nothing, non-beings, nameless, or the work of human hands
values.others_real_but_subordinate: others exist and are ordered below the one in question
values.others_real_and_not_subordinate: others exist and are not ranked under it
values.others_not_addressed: the proposition is silent about any other being
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D2c_worship_exclusivity.question: Is devotion or rite restricted to this divinity?
D2c_worship_exclusivity.note: A normative question. 'Thou shalt have no other gods before me' is evidence here, not in D2b: it commands a practice and says nothing about whether other beings exist. The v1 audit found three worship prohibitions counted as existence claims; this dimension exists so the frame cannot make that mistake again.

values.exclusive_devotion_commanded: rite, prayer or allegiance is owed to this divinity alone
values.devotion_to_others_permitted: the text treats devotion to other beings as legitimate, including when it is describing a practice it disapproves of in another voice
values.devotion_mediated_by_hierarchy: access runs through subordinate beings, angels, saints or offices
values.no_devotional_language: the proposition makes no claim about practice at all
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D3_agency.question: What agency is predicated — personhood, will, manner of acting, delegation?
D3_agency.note: Set-valued. Deliberating will, delegated execution and reciprocal dependency coexist in ordinary religious texts; the old single label made them compete.

values.personalhood_mind_and_will: the divine is spoken of as having mind, will and the capacity to be addressed
values.effortless_self_evolution: produces without deliberation or labour: emanation, self-differentiation
values.law_without_will: cosmos runs by an impersonal regularity that is itself sacred
values.delegated_execution: authorship is nominal; subordinates, angels, fate-figures or offices do the work
values.reciprocal_dependency: the divine needs human rite, sacrifice or prayer to remain effective
values.non_agential: the divine is contemplative, immobile, does nothing
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D4_cosmic_function.question: What work is the divinity credited with?
D4_cosmic_function.note: Set-valued, unchanged from the previous release; the values and their detectors are inherited verbatim.

values.creating_ex_nihilo_or_by_word: bringing world into being, often by utterance or command
values.generating_by_procreation: world and gods issued by begetting, birth or union
values.dissolving_or_reabsorbing: ending or drawing the world back into itself
values.revealing_teaching_lawgiving: communicating knowledge or statute to humans
values.rescuing_healing_restoring: soteriological action toward humans in a damaged condition
values.fertilisingWeather_agricultural: storm, dew, grain, fertility: the divine as livelihood guarantee
values.guarding_localised: defence of a place, people, house or cult site
values.no_function_attributed: invoked but credited with no cosmic or human work
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D5_universe_relationship.question: What is the relation between divinity and the world?
D5_universe_relationship.note: Set-valued, and the composite value 'other_and_indwelling' is gone: transcendence and immanence are two labels that may both apply, which is what the texts actually say.

values.wholly_other: the divine and the world are distinct kinds; the world does not contain or constitute it
values.indwelling_in_world: the divine is present within the world or within its worshipers
values.identical_with_world: the cosmos itself, or its totality, is the divine
values.world_in_divine_not_exhausting: the world is within the divine but does not exhaust it
values.retreated_or_absent: a deity made the world and withdrew, was displaced, or is inaccessible
values.world_as_appearance: the cosmos is unreal, degraded or illusory relative to the divine
values.scale_not_claimed: the divine is bound to places, animals, lineage or cult; no cosmic-scale claim
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D6_temporal_nature.question: What is the divinity's relation to time, to beginning and to end?
D6_temporal_nature.note: Set-valued. Eternal existence, cyclic recurrence and an eschatological function are three properties, not three mutually exclusive answers to one question.

values.uncreated_eternal: no beginning; exists necessarily or from ever
values.born_in_time: has a genealogy, a birth, a youngest generation
values.cyclically_recurrent: divine acts or ages return on a measurable cycle
values.linear_once: one creation and one consummation; history does not repeat
values.eschatologically_future: the decisive divine reality is still to arrive
values.from_lost_past: the divine walked with humans and has departed
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D7a_speaker_attribution.question: Who is the utterer this text prints in this proposition?
D7a_speaker_attribution.note: Attribution only. The previous release mixed the speaker with the act, the genre and the text's stance.

values.divine_self_speech: the divine speaks in the first person within the proposition
values.narrator_or_scribe: the framing voice of the text reports
values.character_within_narrative: a figure in the story speaks; the text is not speaking
values.opponent_or_denier: a claimant the text sets itself against speaks
values.editorial_or_ethnographic_frame: a compiler, collector or missionary reports what others hold
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D7b_speech_act.question: What act is performed in this proposition?
D7b_speech_act.note: The illocutionary question, alone: asserting, addressing, commanding, questioning, conditioning, reporting, denying, boasting, or negating apophatically.

values.address_or_praise: spoken to the divine rather than about it
values.command: statute or prohibition; its force is 'you shall'
values.question: interrogative; it seeks rather than concludes
values.report: someone's words or a narrative event are relayed
values.deny: a negation is performed as the act
values.boast: a claimant exalts themselves; the text may or may not agree
values.negate_apophatically: denial performed as worship: no attribute reaches it
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D7c_discourse_genre.question: What kind of discourse carries this proposition?
D7c_discourse_genre.note: Genre is not a speech act: a hymn contains address and doctrine, a prophetic oracle contains command and assertion, a commentary contains report and argument.

values.confessional_formula: a fixed creed or shorthand of belief
values.prophetic_oracle: declared as message, often with a messenger formula
values.commentary_or_description: an outsider or editor describing a belief
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D7d_epistemic_commitment.question: Does the framing text commit to the proposition, attribute it, reject it, or hold it open?
D7d_epistemic_commitment.note: Commitment is neither speaker nor act. An opponent may assert; a narrator may report; whether the text means the proposition to be so is answered by the frame around the clause. This is the question the previous release silently merged into speech act, and the reason a conditional could be read as an atheist confession.

values.endorsed_by_text: the framing voice presents the proposition as so
values.attributed_not_endorsed: the text relays the proposition without committing to it
values.rejected_in_text: the framing voice sets the proposition against what it holds to be true
values.suspended_or_held_open: question or condition: the text leaves it open
values.not_applicable_non_assertive: the proposition is address, praise or command, so 'does the text assert it' has no application
values.undecidable: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

transformation_operators.purpose: An inheritance hypothesis predicts that a later state is reachable from an earlier one by an operator this table admits. A convergence hypothesis predicts the same state arises by a different route. Naming the operators is what makes the two hypotheses distinguishable rather than a matter of taste.

operators.elevation: a subordinate or junior divine becomes the supreme term while retaining attributes
operators.demotion: a divine becomes a demon, angel, saint, ancestor or spirit — the being survives, the rank does not
operators.absorption: two named terms merge, one name survives and inherits the other's functions
operators.abstraction: an agent becomes a principle (a personal creator is re-described as ground, law, or the absolute)
operators.personification: a principle becomes an agent (order, fate, fortune, the city's good takes a face and a temple)
operators.euhemerisation: the divine is re-explained as a deified human, usually with an invented genealogy or a travel route
operators.negation_inversion: the successor claim reuses the predecessor's grammar with its polarity flipped; the denial of a god is worded exactly as that god's confession
operators.functional_transfer: attributes migrate to a new holder without the holder's ontology changing (storm-power to creator, law-giving to a king)
operators.scope_narrowing: a cosmic term is re-applied to a people, city, cult or household
operators.scope_expansion: a local term is re-applied to the whole cosmos, often by absorbing rivals
operators.differentiation: one term splits into two or more with divided functions, often after a textual tradition grows commentarial
operators.nominalisation: a verb or title hardens into a proper name (or a name into a title), which is how translations silently create or destroy monotheism
operators.silencing: a term is removed by an editor, redactor or censor; absence in a recension is an event, not a datum

transformation_operators.discipline: An operator may only be asserted when (a) both states are attested with locators, (b) the earlier state's date is not later than the later state's date, (c) a contact, transmission or dependence relation between the two expressions is documented, and (d) at least one independent witness rules out the coincidence of a translator's habit. Two of these four being unmet yields `undecidable`, not a transformation claim.

M1_single_ancestral_concept_then_transfo.claims: One ancestral divine-concept state, from which the attested states descend by the operators above, diversifying as it travels.
predicts: a small set of root states concentrated in the earliest dated strata of a connected region
descendant states reachable by the fewest admissible operators from one root
operator signatures preserved across languages even where surface vocabulary differs
shared arbitrary non-functional detail — a predicative structure with no reason to recur — travelling with the contact chain
gradient of dissimilarity increasing with dated distance from the root
M1_single_ancestral_concept_then_transfo.if_true_we_would_see: A low parsimony score on a single root that explains most of the attested state distribution, and dated first attestations ordered consistently with transmission.

M2_multiple_independent_origins.claims: Divinity-concepts arise separately in lineages without contact; similarity is limited or none.
predicts: root states in strata with no documented contact route
high-frequency surface similarity confined to known translation reuse, not shared arbitrary detail
operators required that no transmission path can supply
state distributions better predicted by ecology or subsistence than by descent
M2_multiple_independent_origins.if_true_we_would_see: Deep-lineage states sharing nothing but functional pressure, and an inheritance tree whose parsimony gains nothing over per-lineage roots.

M3_regional_inheritance_then_cultural_mi.claims: Several regional roots, each internally inherited, with later cross-regional transfer; the network is reticulate, not treelike.
predicts: strong phylogenetic signal within regions and weak or conflicting signal between them
borrowing edges with dates later than both endpoints
the same state reached by different operator paths in different regions
hybrid states where two dimensions move together and a third does not
M3_regional_inheritance_then_cultural_mi.if_true_we_would_see: A tree that fits each region well but whose between-region edges are better modelled as transfer; dimension-level profiles that split, with D1 inherited while D2 is replaced.

M4_independent_development_then_converge.claims: Independent origins followed by convergent elaboration because the same cognitive, social or linguistic pressures favour similar states.
predicts: states recurring in lineages with no route and no shared arbitrary detail
recurrence explained by functional or cognitive attractors (agency detection, hierarchy projection, moral policing)
surface vocabulary differing while the state matches
identical operator outcomes appearing without any contact that could transmit them
M4_independent_development_then_converge.if_true_we_would_see: High state recurrence uncorrelated with contact distance, and shared *themes* without shared *arbitrary specifics*.

competing_models.model_comparison_discipline: The four are compared by which predicts the observed distribution of dated states best, not by which is likeliest a priori. Parsimony, contact distance, and the arbitrary-detail test are the three scores. No model is adopted unless it beats the others on a preregistered combination of them, and all four remain live until then.

lexicon_conventions.purpose: Each value owns entries in every language in which it is claimed to be expressible. A value is 'attested in a work' if ANY entry of that value matches in ANY language the work's sources are written in — never merely if an English phrase occurs.
lexicon_conventions.verification_rule: Entries carry `verification_status`. `verified_first_hand` requires the analyst to have read the passage in the source language or in a cited critical edition with page and line. `unverified_secondary_literature` means the entry is a claim taken from a book and has NOT been checked; such entries may generate search candidates but must never be counted as attestations. This project currently has zero `verified_first_hand` original-language entries and that is a gap in the instrument, not a finding about the past.
lexicon_conventions.honesty_note: The English corpus contains transliterated terms (deva, brahman, Elohim, yazata, manitou, Dao) only when a translator chose to leave them; the frame must therefore treat transliterated-term hits as evidence of the term's presence, never as evidence that a tradition lacks a concept whose term was translated away.

semantic_precision_recall.definition: For a dimension value v: precision = (machine matches a human coder also assigns to v) / (all machine matches for v); recall = (all human-assigned v instances that the machine found) / (all human-assigned v instances). Computed per value, not per grammar, so that a value's failure is not hidden by a neighbour's success.
semantic_precision_recall.gold_standard: stratified blinded double-coding of utterance-windows, oversampled for rare values, with disagreement adjudicated and recorded as data rather than resolved silently
semantic_precision_recall.required_report: confusion matrix within each dimension, plus the rate at which `undecidable` was chosen by each coder — coders who never choose it are not reading, and that shows up here
semantic_precision_recall.inter_rater: Cohen kappa for single-valued dimensions, Jaccard or Krippendorff alpha for the set-valued D4; no reliability claim may be made from one coder
semantic_precision_recall.baselines_to_defeat: whitespace-normalised regex, per-work majority prior, and a word-only baseline — the ontology must beat all three or it is decoration

controls.positive: known-dependent pairs must score as dependent (anthology reprints such as quran_sale inside sacred_books_east)
controls.negative: matched pairs from unrelated lineages must not resolve to a shared root state by the operator path
controls.ablation: removing the D7 human-interpretation dimension must reproduce v1's false positives; if it does not, the instrument is not doing what this document claims

what_this_frame_may_not_say: that a concept is absent from a tradition; only that it is not attested here or undecidable
that attestation counts order anything historically until composition and witness dates are separate fields and filled
that a state found in an English translation is a state the tradition held; translation choice, edition and censoring are live confounders
that any of the four models is true, false, or preferred — this is a coding frame and a model-comparison design, not a result
anything at all about whether divine beings exist, which no coding frame addresses

distinctness_status.claim: twelve analytically distinct dimensions, each answering exactly one question
distinctness_status.status_of_the_claim: Declared, not measured. `Orthogonal` is an empirical property: it would mean that knowing one dimension's value tells you nothing about another's, which is a fact about observations and can only be estimated from coded data. What is claimed here is weaker and defensible from the definitions alone: the twelve questions are separately stateable, separately answerable, and no one of them is a restatement of another. Until two independent codings exist, the word is `analytically distinct`.
distinctness_status.what_would_test_it: two independent codings of the packet, then the observed association between every pair of dimensions over the propositions both coders agreed on -- Cramer's V for the single-valued pairs, set overlap for the set-valued ones, and the co-firing rate of values detected by one surface string. A frame whose dimensions are statistically independent would be a stronger instrument than this one claims to be.

conceptual_and_discourse_blocks.why_kept_apart: The D1-D6 block describes what a text says is the case. The D7 block describes the speech situation the sentence sits in, which in this corpus is largely a property of English translation prose and genre convention rather than of the composition's doctrine. Averaging the two blocks into one score lets a shared genre vocabulary -- two catechisms, two sermons, two legal codes -- produce a high similarity that looks conceptual, and lets a genuinely shared concept state read as dissimilar because one rendering put it in a hymn and the other in a narrative. Similarity is therefore reported per block, and the pair is read as a pattern of the two, not as their mean.

d7d_epistemic_commitment_and_doctrinal_e.the_relationship_is_not_two_measurements: In the current build `doctrinal_endorsement` is D7d's value copied onto the record: `tools/divinity_ontology.py` writes `"doctrinal_endorsement": d7d`. It is the same detector reading published as the answer to the frame's second question, not an independent corroboration of it. The one place they can differ is a `not_yet_instrumented` row, where the record forces `doctrinal_endorsement` to `undecidable` while D7d keeps whatever its unvalidated detector matched; everywhere else a record where the two disagree cannot occur, and no agreement between them counts as evidence.
d7d_epistemic_commitment_and_doctrinal_e.the_questions_are_still_different: D7d asks what the framing text commits to -- endorsed, attributed, rejected, suspended, not applicable, undecidable. `doctrinal_endorsement` asks the same of the proposition, as one of the three assertion fields (`conceptual_presence`, `doctrinal_endorsement`, `historical_transmission`) that the frame keeps apart so that a withheld endorsement costs nothing as concept evidence. What is genuinely separate is D7d from D7a (who speaks) and D7b (what act is performed): Pharaoh drowning asserts, and the narrative attributes without endorsing.
d7d_epistemic_commitment_and_doctrinal_e.why_the_field_is_still_published_twice: The three assertion fields are the record contract and the coder-facing columns; D7d is the dimension the detector fills. The copy makes the contract legible on every row and costs nothing, but it must be read as a derived alias. Calling it a second check would be the error this frame was built to remove.
d7d_epistemic_commitment_and_doctrinal_e.what_would_separate_them: The packet already codes both independently: D7d's own column plus `doctrine_endorsed_by_text` as a separate coder question. `tools/score_annotation.py` v3.2 publishes `construct_checks.d7d_and_doctrinal_endorsement`: one coder's D7d answer set against that same coder's endorsement answer, proposition by proposition, reported per coder and per row group, because an association between two fields of one machine record is 1.0 by construction. Until a coder fills both columns it reports `pending_human_coding` and no number. If coders answer them the same way on nearly every proposition, D7d is not carrying information the assertion field does not already carry and the frame should merge them; if they come apart -- a text that endorses a proposition its speaker does not assert, or the reverse -- the duplication is justified and the detectors need separating. Until then the distinction is declared, and the alias is the honest description of the current code.
d7d_epistemic_commitment_and_doctrinal_e.consequence_for_reading: Do not read `doctrinal_endorsement` and `D7d_epistemic_commitment` as two fields of evidence on one record, and do not treat `counts_as_affirmative_doctrine` as a third check on either: it is a conjunction of D7d, D7b and the coverage state, so it inherits D7d's errors exactly.

distinctness_status.residual_risk: Distinctness is a property of the questions, not of the English detectors. Several values are detected by the same surface string (a confession of exclusive devotion populates D2a, D2b and D2c together), so the dimensions are correlated in observation while remaining independent in definition. A reader who treats a co-occurrence as three independent attestations has reintroduced the error this split was designed to remove.

unit_of_analysis.record: one dimension value predicated of one identified referent in one proposition
unit_of_analysis.proposition: the minimal clause that carries a subject and a predicate about a divine referent; the utterance window is retained as context because a proposition read without its window cannot be assigned a speaker or a commitment
unit_of_analysis.why_not_the_window: a window can carry three distinct claims — that a creator made the world, that other beings existed before it, that those beings were subordinate — and coding them as one state produced one ambiguous conceptual reading per paragraph

multilingual_status.self_description: multilingual-ready framework, not an operational multilingual instrument
multilingual_status.source_language_detection: not operational; no lexicon entry has been verified against an original-language source or a critical edition
multilingual_status.consequence: the records this release publishes are evidence about English translation vocabulary, not about the concepts a tradition expressed in its own language
